name: Draggable Image Strip
description: Full-height horizontal strip of numbered portrait images dragged with inertia and overdrag, with a custom cursor. Clicking a number opens a full-screen detail view with title and text.
contents: Horizontal strip of portrait images with varied heights and two-digit index numbers
Corner heading, subheading and a progress indicator bar
Outlined cover title shown while dragging
Full-screen detail view per item with image, title, text and close button
behavior: Pointer drag moves the strip with lerp smoothing and rubber-band overdrag at the ends
While dragging, items shrink, fade and images zoom while the cover title scales in
Clicking an item number slides the items up and reveals the detail view with staggered tweens
Custom circular cursor follows the mouse and grows over numbers and while dragging
Touch devices keep the native cursor and vertical page panning
editableByProps: Items: images, titles, detail text and frame size class
Drag feel: smoothing, overdrag, scale and opacity while dragging
Strip height, image aspect and sizes
Toggle indicator, cover title and custom cursor

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the open and close animation sequence

fixed: Requires the gsap npm package, loaded by dynamic import
Height is stripHeight with a minimum of 750px, so the strip does not shrink below that on short screens
Items hidden in the detail view use a fixed 500px tall drag area
